name: Nightmare Twinkle
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 7 or lower Illusion monster from your Deck, except "Nightmare Twinkle", but return it to the hand during the End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Nightmare Twinkle" once per turn. If this card battles a monster, neither can be destroyed by that battle. Once per turn, at the end of the Damage Step, if a monster battled: You can change the battle positions of all monsters on the field.

name: Invincible Rocket Warrior
desc: Cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Invincible Rocket Warrior" once per turn. You can send 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand, then you can make 1 monster your opponent controls lose 1500 ATK, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion Monsters. When this card declares an attack: You can add 1 Level 4 Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: The Legendary Insect Queen
desc:
2 monsters that mention "Dark Time Wizard", and/or Level 1 EARTH Tokens
Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by Tributing the above monsters. You can only Special Summon "The Legendary Insect Queen" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add up to 2 cards that mention "Dark Time Wizard" from your GY and/or banishment to your hand. Your opponent cannot target other cards you control that mention "Dark Time Wizard" with card effects.

name: Number 96: Dark Manipulator
desc:
3 Level 2 DARK monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card; this card gains ATK equal to the total original ATK of all monsters your opponent currently controls. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can send this card with material to the GY; Special Summon "Umbral Horror" and/or "Malicevorous" monsters from your GY up to the number of materials this card had. You can only use each effect of "Number 96: Dark Manipulator" once per turn.

name: Chaos Barian's Change
desc: Target 1 "Masquerade" Xyz Monster you control; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Number" monster that is 1 Rank higher or 2 Ranks lower than that monster you control, by using it as material (this is treated as an Xyz Summon, transfer its materials). You can banish this card from your GY, then target 3 "Umbral Horror" monsters and/or "Masquerade" Xyz Monsters in your GY; place them on the bottom of the Deck in any order, then draw 1 card. You can only use 1 "Chaos Barian's Change" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

name: Ashtrata Tamayori
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 "Ashtra" non-Tuner from your Deck in Defense Position, then you can change 1 face-up monster you control to face-down Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Synchro Summon using a Level 1 Tuner. If an "Ashtra" and/or face-down card(s) you control would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Ashtrata Tamayori" once per turn.

name: Ashtrama Yoami
desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned, or sent from the field to the GY: You can add to your hand, or Set, 1 "Ashtra" Trap from your Deck. If you have a Trap in your GY: You can return as many face-down cards on the field as possible to the hand, then if you have 5 or more Traps in your GY, you can return all cards your opponent controls to the hand. You can only use each effect of "Ashtrama Yoami" once per turn.

name: Rampant Wings of Atlantis
desc: This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Rampant Wings of Atlantis" once per turn. You can send this card from your hand and 1 Spell/Trap or "Umi" from your hand or face-up field to the GY, then target 1 card your opponent controls; send it to the GY. If you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon": You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Sea Serpent monster from your hand or Deck.

name: Codaedalus
desc:
2 WATER monsters
You can only Special Summon "Codaedalus(s)" once per turn. This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field. If this card is Link Summoned: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 card from your GY to your hand that mentions "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon", except "Codaedalus". Once per turn: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; send up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field to the GY.

name: Power of the Duelist
desc:
Declare 2, 3, or 4 Attributes; apply this effect based on the number declared, also during the End Phase of this turn, you must send all cards you control to the GY, unless you have activated effects of monsters of all declared Attributes in your field and/or GY this turn.
● 2: Target 1 monster on the field; banish it.
● 3: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1 card.
● 4: Negate the effects of 2 face-up cards on the field.
You can only activate 1 "Power of the Duelist" per turn.

name: Amazoness Dramatic Rescue
desc:
You can only use the ① and ② effects of this card's name each once per turn. If you control a "Harpie Lady" monster or "Amazoness" monster, you can activate this card the turn it was Set.
①：Target 1 monster on the field; Special Summon 1 "Harpie" or "Amazoness" monster from your hand or Deck, and if you do, return the targeted monster to the hand.
②：You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Harpie" or "Amazoness" monster from your GY or banishment to your hand.

name: Eyelluring Mirror Wall
desc:
①：Gains these effects while you control an "Amazoness" monster or "Harpie Lady" monster.
● Face-up monsters your opponent controls are changed to Attack Position and must attack if able.
● Once per battle, when an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can halve its ATK.
②：Once per turn, during the Standby Phase: You can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your GY or banishment that mentions "Harpie Lady", except "Eyelluring Mirror Wall".

name: Amazoness Chain Master - Brink of Death Chain Dance
desc: If this card is sent to the GY and you have another "Amazoness" monster in your GY: You can pay 1000 LP; your opponent can choose 1 Level 10 monster in their Deck or Extra Deck, and if they do, you can Special Summon it to your field, ignoring its Summoning conditions, but neither player can activate its effects this turn. If they do not, you discard 1 random card from their hand. You can only use this effect of "Amazoness Chain Master - Brink of Death Chain Dance" once per turn.

name: Amazoness Fighter - Instant Kill Dance
desc: If this card is added to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck that mentions "Harpie Lady". During damage calculation, if your "Amazoness" monster battles an opponent's monster: You can activate this effect; for that battle, neither monster can be destroyed by battle, also you take no battle damage. You can only use each effect of "Amazoness Fighter - Instant Kill Dance" once per turn.

name: Amazoness Spellcaster - Forbidden Spell Dance
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Amazoness" monster from your Deck to your hand, except a Level 3 monster. During your Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 EARTH or WIND Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field. During damage calculation, if your "Amazoness" monster battles an opponent's monster: You can banish this card from your GY; switch the battling monsters' ATK until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Amazoness Spellcaster - Forbidden Spell Dance" once per turn.

name: Harpie Lady - Alluring Dance
desc:
You can only use the ② and ③ effects of this card's name each once per turn.
①：This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while in the field or GY.
②：During the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can target 1 EARTH or WIND monster you control; return it to the Deck/Extra Deck, and if you do, Special Summon this card.
③：If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand that mentions "Harpie Lady".

name: Amazoness Swordmaster
desc:
2 "Amazoness" monsters
You can only use the ① and ③ effects of this card's name each once per turn.
①：If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Amazoness" monster from your Deck.
②：When your "Amazoness" monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can draw 1 card.
③：(Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 Effect Monster on the field; it loses 500 ATK, also its effects are negated.

name: Triangle Ecstasy Harpie Lady Sisters
desc:
3 "Harpie Lady" monsters
Must first be Fusion Summoned.
①：This card's name becomes "Harpie Lady" while in the field or GY.
②：Gains 500 ATK for each "Harpie Lady" in your GY. Your opponent cannot target this card with non-WIND monsters' effects.
③：Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls.

name: Elegant Tri-Mirror
desc:
You can only use the ① and ② effects of this card's name each once per turn.
①：Add 1 "Harpie" monster from your Deck to your hand, then if only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon 1 "Harpie Lady", or 1 monster that mentions it, from your hand or GY.
②：You can banish this card from your GY; Fusion Summon 1 EARTH or WIND Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand or field.

name: Harpie & Amazoness Rakshasa Formation
desc:
You can only activate 1 card with this card's name per turn.
①：Target 1 "Harpie" or "Amazoness" monster in your GY or banishment; Special Summon it, then you can apply 1 of these effects based on the number of "Harpie Lady" monsters and "Amazoness" monsters you control.
● 1+: Place 1 "Eyelluring Mirror Wall" from your Deck face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone.
● 2+: Take control of 1 monster your opponent controls.
● 3+: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

name: Primrose the Twin Rikka Fairy
desc: If a monster(s) is Tributed: You can Special Summon this card from your hand and 1 "Rikka" monster from your Deck, except "Primrose the Twin Rikka Fairy", in Defense Position, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Plant monsters. You can target 1 Plant monster you control; increase or decrease its Level by 2. During your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Plant Xyz Monster. You can only use each effect of "Primrose the Twin Rikka Fairy" once per turn.

name: Rikka Black Princess
desc: If you control no monsters, or all monsters you control are Plant monsters: You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY, but banish it when it leaves the field, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Plant monsters. You can Tribute 1 Plant monster from your hand or field; Special Summon 1 "Rikka" monster from your Deck, except "Rikka Black Princess". You can only use each effect of "Rikka Black Princess" once per turn.

name: Teardrop the Rikka Empress
desc:
2 Level 10 Plant monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using "Teardrop the Rikka Queen" you control (transfer its materials). (Quick Effect): You can detach up to 6 materials from this card; send that many Spells/Traps on the field to the GY, then you can Tribute 1 monster on the field. You can only use this effect of "Teardrop the Rikka Empress" once per turn. Each time a monster(s) is Tributed: Attach 1 card from your opponent's GY to 1 Plant Xyz Monster you control.

name: Rikka Empress Strenna
desc:
2 Level 6 Plant monsters
You can detach 2 materials from this card; Special Summon 1 Plant Xyz Monster from your Extra Deck in Defense Position, except "Rikka Empress Strenna", then if you Special Summoned a "Rikka" monster, you can attach 1 "Rikka" monster from your Deck to it. If a monster(s) is Tributed: You can Set 1 "Rikka" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Rikka Empress Strenna" once per turn.

name: Rikka June Moon
desc: When you activate this card, you can also Tribute 1 Plant monster; take 2 "Rikka" monsters from your Deck with the same Level, but different names, add 1 of them to your hand and send the other to the GY, also if you Tributed a monster at activation, your opponent cannot target "Rikka" monsters you control with card effects this turn. For the rest of this turn after this card resolves, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Plant Xyz Monsters. You can only activate 1 "Rikka June Moon" per turn.

name: Castle of Vampire
desc: When this card is activated: Special Summon 1 DARK Zombie monster from your Deck or GY. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card. That monster is unaffected by the activated effects of other non-DARK monsters. If this face-up card leaves the field: Destroy as many cards you control as possible, and if you do, take 400 damage for each card destroyed. You can only activate 1 "Castle of Vampire" per turn.

name: Necromancer of Dragon Magic
desc:
2 Effect Monsters
During your Main Phase: You can reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck, choose 1 non-Fusion Monster in your GY whose name is mentioned on the revealed monster, and this card's name becomes that monster's (until the End Phase), then you can Fusion Summon the revealed Fusion Monster, by banishing its materials from your hand, field, and/or GY, also you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of this turn, except Fusion Monsters. You can only use this effect of "Necromancer of Dragon Magic" once per turn.

name: Gandora-X the Blackmetal Rampaging Dragon
desc: If this card is added from the Deck to your hand, except by drawing it: You can Special Summon it. If this card is Special Summoned: You can pay half your LP; destroy as many other monsters on the field as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the highest ATK on the field among the destroyed face-up monsters they own, and if you do that, this card gains that much ATK. If this card is destroyed: You can add 1 "Final Geas" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gandora-X the Blackmetal Rampaging Dragon" once per turn.

name: Time Chain
desc: Destroy this card during your opponent's ② Standby Phase after activation. Activate this card when your monster is targeted for an attack: Neither battling monster can be destroyed by that battle, also banish them after damage calculation until their controller's ② Standby Phase. Negate the activated effects of monsters with the same original name as monsters that are currently banished by this card's effect. During your Draw Phase, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand.

name: Warrior's Devotion
desc: Send 1 Warrior monster from your hand or Deck to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses ATK equal to the sent monster's ATK. If a Warrior monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Warrior's Devotion" once per turn.

name: Trinitas Magistus
desc:
2+ Spellcaster monsters
You can only use 1 of this card name's ①, ②, or ③ effect per turn, and only once that turn.
①：If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can equip 1 "Magistus" or Spellcaster monster from your Extra Deck to it.
②：You can discard 1 card; shuffle all Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters from your opponent's field and GY into the Extra Deck.
③：During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can add 1 "Magistus" card from your GY or banishment to your hand.

name: Invoked Magistus Heruvim
desc:
1 "Magistus" monster + 1 Spellcaster monster
You can only once use this card name's ① and ② effects once per turn each.
①：If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.
②：When your opponent activates a monster effect, or their monster declares an attack, except during the turn this card was Special Summoned (Quick Effect): You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 "Magistus" or "Invoked" monster from your Extra Deck, except "Invoked Magistus Heruvim".

name: Magistus Witchcrafter Aruru
desc:
You can only use this card name's ①, ②, and ③ effects once per turn each.
①：If this card is in your hand and a "Magistus" monster is on the field: You can Special Summon this card.
②：You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; negate its effects until the end of this turn.
③：If this card is sent to the GY: You can banish it, then target 1 "Magistus" or "Witchcrafter" monster in your GY; Special Summon it.

name: Marincess Azuri
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 WATER Cyberse monster with 1000 or less ATK from your Deck, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WATER monsters. If you Link Summon a "Marincess" Link Monster(s), while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; equip 1 "Marincess" monster from your GY to 1 of those Link Monsters as an Equip Spell that gives it 600 ATK. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Azuri" once per turn.

name: Marincess Ulpis
desc: If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other "Marincess" card or WATER monster; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Marincess" Spell/Trap from your Deck. You can send 1 "Marincess" Link Monster Card you control to the GY; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Marincess Ulpis" once per turn.

name: Aqua Leviathan @Marincess
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with a "Marincess" card. Monsters your opponent controls lose 1000 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Aqua Leviathan @Marincess" once per turn. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Marincess" card from your Deck to your hand, except a Ritual Monster, then discard 1 card. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can return cards your opponent controls to the hand up to the number of "Marincess" Monster Cards you control.

name: Marincess Truth Heart
desc:
2+ "Marincess" monsters
If this card is Link Summoned using a Link Monster with 0 original ATK: You can Special Summon 1 Link-3 or lower "Marincess" monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Marincess Truth Heart" once per turn. You can banish 1 Link Monster Card from your field or GY; destroy 1 card your opponent controls, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot banish monsters with that same Link Rating to activate this effect of "Marincess Truth Heart".

name: Marincess Reef Lagoon
desc: When this card is activated: You can add 1 WATER Cyberse monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can shuffle up to 3 WATER monsters from your GY and/or banishment into the Deck. You can send this face-up card to the GY; Ritual Summon 1 WATER Cyberse Ritual Monster from your hand, by banishing WATER monsters from your GY whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster. You can only activate 1 "Marincess Reef Lagoon" per turn.

name: Ars Magna Artmage
desc:
2+ monsters, including an "Ars Magna" or "Artmage" monster
Your opponent cannot target your linked monsters with card effects. During your Main Phase: You can add to your hand, or Special Summon, 1 "Ars Magna", "Artmage", "DoomZ", or "Elfnote" monster from your Deck, then if you have 3 or more different Monster Types on your field, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your GY or banishment. You can only use this effect of "Ars Magna Artmage" once per turn.

name: Ars Magna DoomZ
desc:
2 monsters, including an "Ars Magna" or "DoomZ" monster
Any monster destroyed by battle with your linked monster is banished. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ars Magna DoomZ" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can destroy, or banish, 1 card you control, then you can shuffle up to 2 cards from any GY(s) into the Deck. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "DoomZ" monster from your hand.

name: Ars Magna Elfnote
desc:
2 monsters, including an "Ars Magna" or "Elfnote" monster
Your linked monsters gain 300 ATK for each different Monster Type on the field. You can only use each of the following effects of "Ars Magna Elfnote" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can send to the GY, or banish, 1 card you control, then you can return 1 monster on the field to the hand. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "Elfnote" monster from your hand.

name: Ars Magna Academic Arcane Apparition Acropolis
desc:
(This card is always treated as an "Artmage" card.)
Your activated "Medius" monsters' effects cannot be negated. If you have a "Power Patron" monster in your GY: You can banish 1 Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster from your GY, and declare 1 "Ars Magna" Link Monster Card name that has not been declared for "Ars Magna Academic Arcane Apparition Acropolis" this turn; Special Summon that monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot be used as Link Material.

name: Omega Vidolium the Power Patron of Heaven's End
desc:
Pendulum Scale = 11
[ Pendulum Effect ]
If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can return this card to the Extra Deck, then you can Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from either field, including a "Power Patron" monster you control.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
3 monsters Special Summoned from the Extra Deck with 3000 or more ATK
Must first be Fusion Summoned. Unaffected by card effects, except "Power Patron" cards'. When your opponent activates a monster effect while they control 2 or more monsters with the same Type as that monster (Quick Effect): You can banish (face-down) the top 3 cards of your Deck; negate the activation, and if you do, banish that monster face-down. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Place this card in your Pendulum Zone.

name: Power Patron Portal Plugging -Sword of Mutual Destruction-
desc: Discard 1 "Power Patron" card; place 1 "Power Patron" Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck in your Pendulum Zone, then if it is a Fusion Monster, you can place 1 "Power Patron" Pendulum Monster from your Deck in your Pendulum Zone. If you control a "Power Patron" monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1500 ATK, also it cannot attack this turn. You can only use each effect of "Power Patron Portal Plugging -Sword of Mutual Destruction-" once per turn.

name: Theorealize Ephemeral Lull
desc:
(This card is always treated as a "Power Patron" card.)
Banish 1 "Medius" monster from your hand or face-up field; banish as many monsters on the field as possible that were Special Summoned from the Extra Deck, then you can Special Summon 1 "Artmage" monster from your GY. If you have 3 or more different Monster Types on your field: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 of your banished "Medius" monsters. You can only use each effect of "Theorealize Ephemeral Lull" once per turn.

name: Heretic Eradicator
desc: When your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster, while this card is in your hand and your opponent has 4 or more monsters that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set in their face-up field, GY, and/or banishment (Quick Effect): You can negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster, and if you do that, Special Summon this card (while you control no monsters, this effect and its activation cannot be negated). You can send this card from the field to the GY; halve the ATK of 1 monster on the field. You can only use each effect of "Heretic Eradicator" once per turn.

name: Counter Spell "Negate Attack"
desc:
During the Battle Phase: Activate 1 of these effects;
● When an opponent's monster declares an attack while they control more monsters than you do: Negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect: Negate that effect, and if you do, destroy that monster.
When you draw for your normal draw in your Draw Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.

name: Karin the Celestial Sage of the Highest Heights
desc:
2 Level 7 monsters
When your opponent activates a card or effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a monster(s) from the Deck (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; your opponent draws 1 card, then negate that activated effect, and if you do, destroy that card. During your Main Phase 2: You can target 1 Level 7 monster in your GY; take damage equal to its ATK, and if you do, return both it and this card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Karin the Celestial Sage of the Highest Heights" once per turn.

name: Card Crawl
desc:
You can banish (face-down) the top 5, 10, or 15 cards of your Deck, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; apply the appropriate effect to it.
● 5: Its ATK/DEF become 0.
● 10: Negate its effects.
● 15: Banish it (face-down).
You can only use this effect of "Card Crawl" once per turn.

name: The Pyramid of Kepher
desc: Send 1 Zombie Ritual Monster from your Deck to the GY; place 1 Field Spell from your Deck or GY face-up on your field, also you cannot activate non-Zombie monster effects for the rest of this turn after this card resolves. If your opponent controls an Effect Monster: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Ritual Monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Pyramid of Kepher" once per turn.

name: Buster Blader, the One Who Surpasses the Limits
desc: If this card is in your hand or GY: You can discard 1 Spell; Special Summon this card, and if you do, its name becomes "Buster Blader", also banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Buster Blader, the One Who Surpasses the Limits" once per turn. Gains 500 ATK for each Attack Position monster your opponent controls. When this card destroys a monster by battle: You can discard 1 card; Special Summon that monster to your field.

name: Lethargisaurus
desc:
1 Defense Position Tuner + 1+ Defense Position non-Tuners
If this card is Special Summoned in Attack Position: Change it to Defense Position. This Defense Position card gains these effects.
● Change all face-up monsters on the field to Defense Position.
● Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to the activation of their own cards or effects.
● Once per turn, during the End Phase: Each player gains 500 LP for each Defense Position monster they control.

name: The Dark Dragon Lord of Ultum
desc: A dragon from another star that awoke from within a sealed underground world. It's a well-known fact even in Dimension Zeta that when you first wake up, you can only exert one-thousandth of your true strength.

name: Javelin Beetle of the Alliance
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Javelin Beetle of the Alliance". During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can reveal this card in your hand; Ritual Summon 1 Insect Ritual Monster from your hand, by Tributing monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level. You can only use this effect of "Javelin Beetle of the Alliance" once per Duel. If this card is Ritual Summoned: You can target 1 other card in this card's column; destroy it, and if you do, this card gains 600 ATK.

name: Bunnillin Soft
desc: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, Normal Monsters you control gain 1000 ATK. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Soft" once per turn. You can target 2 Normal Monsters in your GY with different Types, Attributes, and Levels; Special Summon them. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can add 1 card from your GY to your hand.

name: Bunnillin Extract
desc: While you control 2 or more non-Token Normal Monsters, draw 2 cards instead of 1 for your normal draw during your Draw Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Bunnillin Extract" once per turn. If a card(s) is sent from your opponent's Deck to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand or Deck. If a Level 5 or higher Normal Monster(s) with 2000 or less original ATK/DEF is Special Summoned or declares an attack: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it.

name: Bunnillin: Mocha MOD
desc: You can send 1 Normal Monster with 2000 or less ATK from your Deck to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can place 1 "Bunnillin" Continuous Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY face-up on your field. If your opponent Special Summons an Effect Monster(s), while this card is in the Monster Zone: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY. You can only use each effect of "Bunnillin: Mocha MOD" once per turn.

(Quick Effect): You can banish this revealed card from your hand; destroy all face-up cards your opponent controls. desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 Level 7 or lower monster (Spellcaster or Warrior). While you have 6 or more cards in your hand, negate all your opponent's activated Spell Cards and effects.

If a card(s) in the Field Zone would be destroyed by card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners

name: Tigress in Silent Repose

desc:

2+ Level 4 LIGHT and/or DARK monsters

2 WATER monsters

desc: While you control a "Reindsurm" monster whose original Level is 8 or higher or your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, the activated effects of your "Reindsurm" monsters cannot be negated. Once per turn: You can send 1 "Reindsurm" monster or Dragon monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY; add 1 Insect monster from your Deck to your hand with the same original Level, but a different original name.

name: Reindsurm Butterfly
desc: Send 2 monsters from your Deck to the GY, including an Insect monster, also you cannot Special Summon until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, except Insect monsters. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; all "Reindsurm" monsters you currently control gain 800 ATK/DEF. You can only use 1 "Reindsurm Butterfly" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

name: Reindsurm Practice
desc: Add 2 "Reindsurm" monsters from your Deck to your hand, then send 1 card from your hand to the GY, then if your opponent has a Dragon monster in their field or GY, you can add 1 Insect monster from your GY to your hand. If you Ritual Summon an Insect monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; place 1 "Reindsurm" Field Spell from your Deck face-up on your field. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Practice" once per turn.

name: Reindsurm Encounter
desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated while you control a "Reindsurm" monster: Negate the activation, then you can add 1 "Reindsurm" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand, and if you do, send 1 Insect monster you control to the GY. If a "Reindsurm" monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can place this card from your GY on the bottom of the Deck instead. You can only use each effect of "Reindsurm Encounter" once per turn.

name: Field Power Bonus
desc: If a monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned and there is another monster(s) on the field with the same Type: That Summoned monster(s) gains 1000 ATK/DEF. If this card is destroyed: Negate the effects of all face-up monsters currently on the field, also their ATK/DEF become their original ATK/DEF. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase, if this card is in your GY and there are no cards in the Field Zones: You can place this card face-up on your field.

name: Aroma Strategy
desc:
Once per turn: You can declare 1 card name; reveal the top card of your Deck, and if it is the declared card, you can apply this effect based on its card type. If it is not, destroy this card.
● Monster: Special Summon it.
● Spell/Trap: Set it.
If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Harpie" monster from your Deck or GY.

name: King of Yamimado
desc: While you control a face-down card, this card cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, also your opponent cannot target it with card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "King of Yamimado" once per turn. If this card is in your hand, and "Yami" and/or 2 or more face-down cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card. When a monster on the field with less ATK than this card activates its effect or declares an attack (Quick Effect): You can destroy that monster.

name: Attribute Rejection
desc: Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck; send 1 DARK or Zombie monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY, and if you do, the targeted monster loses ATK equal to the sent monster's original ATK, then if the targeted monster is LIGHT, negate its effects. You can only activate 1 "Attribute Rejection" per turn. If this card was activated as Chain Link 3 or higher, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects in response to this card's activation.

name: Knight of Twin Swords
desc: Can make up to 2 attacks on monsters during each Battle Phase. You can only use each of the following effects of "Knight of Twin Swords" once per turn. If this card is in your hand and you control a card with an effect that requires a die roll: You can Special Summon this card. During your Main Phase: You can roll a six-sided die 3 times, and if you do, this card gains ATK equal to the total x 350 (until the end of this turn), then if 2 or more of the results were the same, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your hand.

name: Flashforce Sword
desc:
Banish (face-up) 1 random card from your opponent's hand (until the Standby Phase of the next turn), then if this card was Set before activation and it banished a monster, you can apply this effect based on its Level.
● 4 or lower: Your opponent banishes all monsters with its same name from their hand, Deck, and GY.
● 5 or higher: Add 1 Level 5 or higher monster with the same Type, Attribute, and/or Level from your Deck to your hand.
You can only activate 1 "Flashforce Sword" per turn.

name: Archfiend of Gilfer - Flame Attack
desc: During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; draw 1 card, then discard 1 card, also all monsters your opponent controls lose 500 ATK this turn. When a monster is destroyed by battle involving your Fiend monster, while this card is in your GY: You can Special Summon this card, but banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use each effect of "Archfiend of Gilfer - Flame Attack" once per turn.

name: Gearfried the Steel Knight
desc: If a monster(s) you control was destroyed by battle or card effect this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, equip 1 monster from your GY to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 800 ATK. During your Main Phase: You can destroy as many cards equipped to this card as possible, then if you destroyed a Monster Card by this effect, you can add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand with the same Attribute and Type as 1 of them, but a different Level. You can only use each effect of "Gearfried the Steel Knight" once per turn.

name: Spell Card "Enemy Controller"
desc:
Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; apply 1 of these effects.
● Destroy it.
● Immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon 1 monster by Tributing monsters including the targeted opponent's monster, even though you do not control it.
During your Main Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; add 1 "Spell Card "Enemy Controller"" from your Deck to your hand. You can only use 1 "Spell Card "Enemy Controller"" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

name: Final Journey of the Soul
desc: When your opponent activates a card or effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a Monster Card(s) from the GY: Negate that effect, and if you do, Special Summon 1 monster from your opponent's GY to their field, then send any number of face-up monsters they control to the GY whose total ATK equal 6000 or less. If this card is banished: You can add it to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves (except during the Damage Step), you can Normal Summon 1 monster from your hand that requires 1 or more Tributes without Tributing. You can only use each effect of "Final Journey of the Soul" once per turn.

name: Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God
desc: You can discard 1 other card; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God", then if your opponent's LP are at least 2000 higher than yours, you can discard 1 random card from their hand. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Helpoemer, Chanter of the Sun God" once per turn.

name: Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God" once per turn.

name: Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God
desc: If this card is in your hand and you control a "Sun God" card: You can Special Summon this card. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 other card in either GY; send 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, place the targeted card on the bottom of the Deck. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God" once per turn.

name: Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God
desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Viser Des Shock, Tormentor of the Sun God" once per turn. If a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY and you control a "Sun God" card, even during the Damage Step: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, return 1 other card on the field to the hand/Extra Deck, and if you do that, inflict 800 damage to your opponent. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand.

name: The Winged Dragon of Ra, Sun God of Darkness
desc:
"The Winged Dragon of Ra" + 3 "Sun God" monsters
Unaffected by other cards' effects. Once per turn, during the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can discard any number of "Sun God" cards, then choose that many of your opponent's occupied Main Monster Zones; your opponent must send the monsters in those zones to the GY. When an attack is declared involving this card: You can pay LP so that you only have 1 left; this card gains ATK/DEF equal to the amount of LP paid and the total ATK of all "Sun God" monsters currently in your GY.

name: Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God
desc:
1 "Sun God" monster you control + 2 face-up monsters on the field
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must be either Fusion Summoned, or Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) to your opponent's Main Monster Zone by sending the above cards from either field to the GY, but if you Special Summon this card with the second method, you can only Special Summon once for the rest of this turn. You can only Special Summon "Lava Golem, Steelcage of the Sun God" once per turn this way, no matter which method you use. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

name: The Immortal Sun God
desc: Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your GY or banishment, ignoring its Summoning conditions, then if you Special Summoned "The Winged Dragon of Ra" by this effect, you can send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your Extra Deck. During the End Phase, send the monsters Special Summoned by this effect to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can discard 1 "Sun God" card; add this card to your hand. You can only use each effect of "The Immortal Sun God" once per turn.

name: The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness
desc: Activate this card by sending 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster from your hand, Deck, or face-up field to the GY. During your Main Phase, if this card was activated this turn: You can add 1 "Sun God" monster from your Deck to your hand. If a monster(s) is destroyed by battle: Its controller takes damage equal to its original ATK, then if you have "The Winged Dragon of Ra" in your GY, you gain 1000 LP. You can only use each effect of "The Sun God Leading Down into Darkness" once per turn.

name: Sun God Domination
desc:
If a "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster is on the field: Apply these effects in sequence.
● Special Summon 1 monster from each GY to your field.
● If "The Winged Dragon of Ra" is on the field, take control of all monsters your opponent controls.
You can banish this card from your GY and Tribute 1 "The Winged Dragon of Ra" monster; gain LP equal to the ATK it had on the field. You can only use each effect of "Sun God Domination" once per turn.

name: Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God
desc:
Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Aqua/WATER/Level 10/ATK 3000/DEF 3000) with the following effects (this card is also still a Trap).
● If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to your hand, then if you added a monster by this effect during your opponent's turn, you can Special Summon it.
● Cannot be destroyed by card effects.
You can only activate 1 "Egyptian God Slime, Protector of the Sun God" per turn.

name: Super Critical
desc:
When this card is activated: You can add 1 card with an effect that requires a die roll from your Deck to your hand. Once per Chain per player, if either player rolls a 1 for a card effect's die roll (except during the Damage Step): They can activate 1 of these effects;
● They destroy up to 3 monsters their opponent controls.
● They destroy 1 monster their opponent controls, and if they do, they negate the effects of 1 monster their opponent controls.
● They Special Summon 1 monster from their GY.
You can only activate 1 "Super Critical" per turn.

name: Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon
desc: If you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon" once per turn. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 DARK Machine monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Barrel Dragon the Machine Dragon". During the Battle Phase, if this card is in your GY because it was sent there from the field this turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon it, and if you do, toss a coin 3 times, then you can destroy monsters on the field up to the number of heads.

name: Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion". Your opponent takes any battle damage you would have taken from battles involving this card. You can only use each of the following effects of "Relinquished the Wicked Eye of Illusion" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can Tribute 2 monsters; Special Summon this card (this is treated as a Ritual Summon). During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate its effects, and if you do, equip it to this card as an Equip Spell that gives it 2000 ATK.

name: Gilford the Lightning, the Warrior of Thunderbolts
desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by Tributing 3 monsters, and if you Tributed a monster(s) that is owned by your opponent, your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when this card is Special Summoned this way. If Summoned this way: Your opponent must send all monsters they control to the GY. If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 Warrior monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Gilford the Lightning, the Warrior of Thunderbolts" once per turn.

name: Penalty Game "GREED, the Illusion of Avarice"
desc: If your opponent added a card(s) from the Deck to the hand this turn, except during the Draw Phase: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent for each card in their hand, then if the total number of cards in their hand, field, and GY is 20 or more, you can banish their entire hand. You can only activate 1 "Penalty Game "GREED, the Illusion of Avarice"" per turn.

name: Zombyra
desc: When this card declares an attack: You lose 500 LP, and if you do, this card gains 500 ATK. When a monster is destroyed by battle: You can equip this card from your GY to the monster that destroyed that monster, then you can destroy the 1 monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (your choice, if tied). The equipped monster's name becomes "Zombyra", also its effects are negated. When the equipped monster declares an attack: Its controller loses 500 LP, and if they do, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK.

name: Evil Dragon Cards - Earth Dragon
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by revealing 3 EARTH monsters in your hand, including this card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Dragon Card" card from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then if a WATER monster is on the field, this card cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects this turn. You can only use each effect of "Evil Dragon Cards - Earth Dragon" once per turn.

name: Evil Dragon Cards - Metal Dragon
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by revealing 3 LIGHT monsters in your hand, including this card. You can reveal this card in your hand; add 1 "Dragon Card" card from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls, and if you do, send this card to the GY, then if an EARTH monster is on the field, you can draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "Evil Dragon Cards - Metal Dragon" once per turn.

name: Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse
desc: If 4 or more cards are on the field: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. You can send up to 2 Spells/Traps you control to the GY; draw that many cards, then you can Special Summon 1 WATER monster from your hand. When your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can change this card to face-down Defense Position, also for the rest of this turn, all face-down cards you control cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects, and your opponent cannot target them with card effects. You can only use each effect of "Audhumla, Progenitor of the Frozen Expanse" once per turn.

name: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant
desc:
"Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" + "Blue-Eyes White Dragon"
Cannot be destroyed by card effects, also unaffected by your opponent's activated effects during your opponent's turn. Can make up to 3 attacks during each Battle Phase. Once per Chain, during the Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can target 1 monster that was Special Summoned this turn, or 1 face-down card, that your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the God-Surpassing Servant" thrice per turn.

name: Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion
desc:
"Dark Magician" + 1 Level 7 or higher monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 500 ATK for every other monster on the field. Can attack all your opponent's monsters, once each. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then you can destroy 1 card on the field. After this card destroys a card by battle or card effect and sends it to the GY, neither player can activate its effects while it is in the GY.
